contract.namelessControls: An icon-only control must carry an accessible name: aria-label, or the kit prop that becomes one.
contract.imagesWithoutAlt: Every declares alt, empty when the image is decoration.
contract.positiveTabIndex: Tab order is the document order. A positive tabIndex overrides it and strands whatever it forgot.
contract.fakeButtons: A click handler belongs on a button or a link. A div needs role, tabIndex and a key handler to be one — and then it should have been a button.
